title: Segoe UI Symbol runs and emoji fallback glyphs size the line by their own face box
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF, pymupdf rawdict baselines: declared Segoe UI Symbol (own copy, 1.3301) lifts TNR 12 / Calibri 11 / Arial 11 to 15.84-16.08 / 14.64-14.88 / 14.40-14.64; emoji with no face, Arial Unicode MS or a missing name draw in Apple Color Emoji (hhea 800/250 over 800 = 1.3125): 15.60-15.84 / 14.40 / 14.40; a declared Segoe UI Emoji run keeps the text line; U+2610 without a face falls to Segoe UI Symbol; line=276 multiplies the lifted line by 1.15
